identificationModule.briefTitle: Safety and Efficacy of Annual or Biannual Doses of Moxidectin or Ivermectin for Onchocerciasis
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Double Blind, Parallel Trial in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) Comparing the Safety and Efficacy of Annual or Biannual Doses of Moxidectin or Ivermectin for Treatment of Onchocerciasis

descriptionModule.briefSummary:
The primary purpose of this phase 3b study is to determine the safety and efficacy of moxidectin administration twice a year, compared to once a year, in maintaining undetectable levels in skin of O. volvulus microfilaria in skin, the parasite that causes river blindness.

Secondary purposes are to determine the effectiveness of moxidectin compared to ivermectin once or twice a year in maintaining undetectable levels, or reducing levels, of skin microfilaria.

designInfo.interventionModelDescription: Participants will be assigned to four groups: annual ivermectin; annual moxidectin; biannual ivermectin; or biannual moxidectin

armGroups.label: Annual Moxidectin
armGroups.description: Moxidectin 8mg per oral, administered annually for 24 months

armGroups.label: Biannual Moxidectin
armGroups.description: Moxidectin 8mg per oral, administered biannually for 24 months

armGroups.label: Annual Ivermectin
armGroups.description: Ivermectin (approximately) 150 micrograms/kg per oral, administered annually for 24 months

armGroups.label: Biannual Ivermectin
armGroups.description: Ivermectin (approximately) 150 micrograms/kg per oral, administered biannually for 24 months

primaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of moxidectin annual and biannual recipients with sustained microfilarial response at month 12
primaryOutcomes.description: Proportion of recipients with zero Onchocerca volvulus microfilariae/mg skin at all post-treatment timepoints to month 12

primaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence and severity of adverse events
primaryOutcomes.description: Incidence and severity of adverse events, vital signs and liver function tests

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of participants in all dose groups with sustained microfilariae response
secondaryOutcomes.description: Proportion of participants with zero Onchocerca volvulus microfilariae/mg skin
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 6 months, 12 months, 18 months, 24 months, 30 months, 36 months

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Sustained ocular microfilariae response in all dose groups
secondaryOutcomes.description: Proportion of participants with 0 live O. volvulus microfilariae in the anterior chambers of the eyes at all post-Baseline assessments in those with liver ocular microfilariae before the first treatment
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 6 months, 12 months, 18 months, 24 months, 30 months, 36 months

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Skin microfilarial density in all dose groups
secondaryOutcomes.description: Mean, median and percentage reduction Onchocerca volvulus microfilariae/mg skin from baseline
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 6 months, 12 months, 18 months, 24 months, 30 months, 36 months

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Ocular microfilariae response in all dose groups
secondaryOutcomes.description: Proportion of participants in all dose groups with 0 Onchocerca volvulus microfilariae/mg skin and 0 live microfilariae in the anterior chambers of the eyes each timepoint
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 6 months, 12 months, 18 months, 24 months, 30 months, 36 months

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Mean skin microfilariae density at each post-Screening assessment
secondaryOutcomes.description: Mean and mean change from baseline of Onchocerca volvulus microfilariae/mg skin
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 6 months, 12 months, 18 months, 24 months, 30 months, 36 months

otherOutcomes.measure: Signs and symptoms of onchocerciasis in all dose groups
otherOutcomes.description: Proportion of participants with signs and symptoms of onchocerciasis with these signs and symptoms at baseline.
otherOutcomes.timeFrame: 6 months, 12 months, 18 months, 24 months, 30 months, 36 months

otherOutcomes.measure: Viability and fertility of male and female macrofilariae in all dose groups
otherOutcomes.description: Histopathological assessment of male and female macrofilariae excised from participants with palpable nodules

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Provision of written informed consent, or assent with parental or guardian written consent.
* Mean ≥ 10 O. volvulus microfilariae/mg skin, determined by four skin snips
* Living in a village selected for the study.
* Age ≥ 12 years.
* All female participants of childbearing potential must commit to the use of a reliable method of birth control for the duration of treatment and until 3 months after completion of dosing with investigational product.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant or breast-feeding.
* Any concurrent condition that, in the opinion of the Investigator, would preclude evaluation of response to treatment or would pose undue risk to the participant's health.
* Has received ivermectin, oral diethylcarbamazine (DEC) or doxycycline (for \> 2 weeks) within 6 months of Baseline.
* Has received treatment with an investigational agent within the last 30 days (or 5 half-lives, whichever is longer) prior to Baseline.
* Known or suspected allergy to ivermectin or moxidectin or their excipients.
* Self-reported planned or ongoing activities within the study period that would make it unlikely that a participant will be available for all planned treatment rounds and follow-up examinations.
* Weight \> 88 kg.
* Infection with Loa loa.
